Overview

Hurghada is a city in Red Sea with a population of 160,000. A premier Red Sea resort city with stunning beaches, world-class diving, and a vibrant waterfront promenade. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 350 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 25.0.
